record_title: Sharp two-lag variance envelopes for positive reversible Markov chains
provenance: Sharp consequences of the spectral moment representation for a fixed observable of a positive reversible Markov chain, using two-moment compact-support extremal inequalities and explicit finite-state realizations.
limitations: Requires nonnegative spectrum and exact population autocorrelations; applies to one fixed observable. The general truncated moment machinery is classical, and terminology-equivalent prior coverage remains a residual originality risk.
